items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The personnel was as follows: Louis Nelson, trombone; Blakeney, trumpet; Sammy Lee, clarinet and vocals; Alton Purnell, piano and vocals; Adolphus Morris, bass; Barry Martyn, drums.

ctx.x: His name was Mosby--Morris was their last name, you know. I can't think of his name.
Perhaps it will come to you--to the two of us.
